service.method: SELECT GWAH.HOUSE_CODE , GWAH.COMPANY_CODE , GETCOMPANYNAME(GWAH.HOUSE_CODE, GWAH.COMPANY_CODE, '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS COMPANY_NAME , GWAH.LINE_TYPE , GWAH.LINE_TYPE_NAME , GWAH.APP_TYPE , GWAH.CODE , GETCODETEXT1( 'AP001', GWAH.APP_TYPE, '#session.LANGUAGE#' , '#session.HOUSE_CODE#') AS APP_TYPE_TEXT , CASE WHEN LINE_TYPE = '03' THEN (SELECT ACCOUNT_NAME FROM SAMST WHERE LANGUAGE = '#session.LANGUAGE#' AND ACCOUNT_CODE = GWAH.CODE AND ROWNUM = 1) WHEN LINE_TYPE = '02' THEN GETDEPTNAME( GWAH.HOUSE_CODE, GWAH.COMPANY_CODE, GWAH.CODE, 'KO' ) END AS CODE_TEXT FROM SGWAH GWAH WHERE GWAH.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWAH.COMPANY_CODE IN ($IN{F_COMPANY_CODE}) AND GWAH.LINE_TYPE = ${LINE_TYPE} AND ( 1 = 1 AND LINE_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%' )
